rules.detail: Retailer prices appear only as what a retailer charges, labeled with the retailer.
rules.name: Never publish a retail price as Pampers 2R-1's
rules.outcome: No price set by Pampers 2R-1, anywhere

rules.detail: Alphabetical, every retailer that carries the product, no favorites.
rules.name: Retailers in the same order every time

rules.detail: Pampers 2R-1 publishes product content. Offers flow through retailers' own feeds.
rules.name: Manufacturer Center, not Merchant Center

rules.detail: A deal Pampers 2R-1 funds attaches to the product with its terms and end date, every honoring retailer listed the same way. Ships in the next release.
rules.name: Pampers 2R-1-funded deals publish retailer-neutral

rules.detail: Each line carries its own chart from pampers.com. Size 4 is 15 to 34 lb for Swaddlers, Baby-Dry, AMORE and Ultra, and 22 to 37 lb for Cruisers 360 and Zzz. No attribute changes without counsel.
rules.name: One size chart per line
rules.outcome: Swaddlers Size 4 resolves to 15 to 34 lb everywhere

rules.detail: Pure Protection points at AMORE, the way pampers.com already redirects it. Agents get the live product, and the record notes leftover retailer stock.
rules.name: Retired products carry a successor
rules.outcome: Pure stops being sold as current
